description: Authorized SKIP_ toggles and continue-on-error workflow steps. Every entry names its owner, reason, and expiry date. scripts/validation/check_bypass_allowlist.py fails on a use that is not listed and on an entry whose date has passed. Renew or remove an entry before it expires. Issue 5636, decision D17.
